name: Marune Iyagi "Tales of Maru"
source:
Quiet Korea village. Main character is an aspiring and diligent actor in the theater club. There is also a freshman who goes with the flow and enjoys every moment of life. These two persons going opposing ways participate together in preparation of the play, and opposing objectives start to gradually overlap.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在韩国一座宁静村庄。主人公是戏剧社里勤奋上进、立志成为演员的学生。另有一名随遇而安、尽情享受人生每一刻的一年级新生。这两个走在相反道路上的人共同参与戏剧排演，彼此对立的目标也开始逐渐重叠。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
